entry_state: Facility capacity, requests and actual receipts are distinct. Missing acknowledgement preserves alternative settlement histories; supported cash must be recorded even after a control violation. Accounting, prudential assessment and behavioural policy retain separate evidence. The review now turns to insurance service, finance and claims.
exit_state: Insurance cash, service and profit follow different schedules. Gross and reinsurance groups retain separate measurement, and general measurement distinguishes future coverage, incurred claims, risk adjustment and unearned margin. The two-year case now tests those components.
findings: The short-cohort example reconciles assets 119, liabilities 72 and equity 47 without netting reinsurance. Risk transfer equal to one half is supplied, not a universal rule.
The tiny chain ladder gives outstanding amounts 36 and 112 but cannot estimate tail variance from one observation or supply an IFRS risk adjustment.
Group boundaries and recognition precede calculation. A missing probability law or risk-adjustment support keeps measurements conditional. No new defect observed.
